verdict.rationale: Leaving looks feasible. The gateway is open-sourced and can be run locally with a single command, and integration is just a base-URL change on OpenAI-compatible SDKs, so lock-in is low. However, nothing in the pack documents exporting logs, configs, prompts or other account data in open formats; logs are only described as viewable and shareable via URL. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of logs/prompts/configs, open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), an export API, account-deletion/offboarding docs, and independent corroboration.
